brainlife.desc: DSI Studio FIB file (fib.gz): reconstructed fibre orientations and anisotropy per voxel in a gzipped MATLAB v4 file, for DSI Studio tracking.
brainlife.name: neuro/dsistudio/fib

original.desc: The FIB file (*.fib.gz) stores the vector field (fiber orientations) and anisotropy information (the magnitude) that can be used by DSI Studio to conduct fiber tracking. The FIB files are MATLAB matrix file stored in V4 version. The fib.gz files are the FIB files compressed by gzip. To load an FIB file into Matlab, extract the *.fib.gz file into an uncompressed .fib file. Then rename the .fib file to .mat file and load it using Matlab.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** DSI Studio fibre tracking and automatic tract segmentation.

**Not for:** Non-DSI Studio tracking Apps.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.dsistudio.fib.json
